notes: Account snapshot: mid-size health-tech company building an internal clinical search layer for provider documentation, HIE notes, and discharge summaries.
Primary ask: highly accurate RAG for clinician-facing search + ranked list reranking to minimize hallucinations; strict PHI controls (per-request identity, SSO, audit trail).
Scale profile: anticipate indexing 25–40M clinical documents (notes, reports) initially; ~120M embedding vectors after sectioning/augmentation. Growth plan to 100M+ documents within 18 months.
Latency / throughput targets: median retrieval + rerank end-to-end under 250ms for single-shot queries; P99 under 800ms; sustained 400 qps for batched clinician workflows (peak 800 qps).

Model preferences: open-model first (Llama-derivatives, Mistral) for private deployment; fallback to hosted smaller models for peak traffic; cross-encoder reranker for top-10 candidates.
Security constraints: must run in VPC with private control plane or on-prem; KMS/HSM integration for key material; full audit logging with immutable retention and per-request user id; BAA required.
